name: nvm
description: Node Version Manager - POSIX-compliant bash script to manage multiple active node.js versions.
one_liner: A free, widely-used command-line tool that lets a developer switch between different versions of Node.js on their own computer.
buyer: There is no buyer here — this is free, foundational developer infrastructure that almost every JavaScript developer already uses, not a product anyone would pay for.
business_use_cases: A development team relies on it (via a project's .nvmrc file) so every engineer automatically runs the same Node.js version, avoiding 'works on my machine' bugs.
A bootcamp includes it in their standard environment setup instructions so students all start from an identical, working Node.js install.

money_ideas.idea: None realistic for this specific tool — it's ubiquitous, free, and not something to build a business around directly.

steal_this: Nothing to steal here — it's plumbing everyone already uses for free. Worth flagging separately: this trending listing's description contains an unrelated cryptocurrency token string appended to it, which has nothing to do with the legitimate nvm project and should be treated as spam, not a feature or endorsement.
